chapters.label: Live: World Cup 2024
chapters.text: The 2024 Futsal World Cup, the match for bronze, in Tashkent. Ukraine lead France four one. Keeper Sukhov saves, and Danyil Abakshyn strikes from his own half. Goal! Five one!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. He waits for the ball to drop, then strikes. Nineteen seconds later he scores again, then again: a hat-trick! Ukraine win seven one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: This is his trick: back to goal, he turns and pokes it with his toe, before the keeper is set!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: a quick toe-poke can beat the keeper before they are set!
